name: agentcad
description: Design, validate, inspect, and export parametric 3D CAD models with the open-source AgentCAD CLI.

interface.longDescription: Use the open-source AgentCAD CLI in a shell-capable local or Codex Cloud environment to design, validate, inspect, render, and export parametric 3D parts and assemblies.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentCAD to design a dimensioned 3D part, validate it, and return preview and CAD files.
